translations.text: God, most high Father of the faithful, you multiply the children of your promise throughout the whole world through the outpouring of the grace of adoption, and through the paschal sacrament you make Abraham your servant the father of all nations, as you swore. Grant that your peoples may enter worthily into the grace of your call. Through Christ our Lord. R. Amen.

translations.text: God, whose ancient wonders we perceive still shining in our own times, through the water of rebirth you accomplish for the salvation of the nations what the power of your right hand once bestowed on one people freed from Pharaoh's persecution. Grant that the fullness of the whole world may enter among Abraham's children and share in Israel's dignity. Through Christ our Lord. R. Amen.

translations.text: God, in the light of the New Testament you have revealed the wonders accomplished in earliest times, so that the Red Sea might be an image of the sacred font, and the people freed from slavery might foreshadow the Christian people's mysteries. Grant that all nations, having obtained Israel's privilege through the merit of faith, may be reborn by sharing in your Spirit. Through Christ our Lord. R. Amen.

Through Christ our Lord. R. Amen.

translations.text: God, unchanging power and eternal light, look graciously upon the mystery of the whole Church, and carry out the work of human salvation in greater peace through the effect of your unending design. May the whole world experience and see the fallen raised up, the old made new, and all things restored to wholeness through Christ himself, from whom they took their beginning. Who lives and reigns for ever and ever. R. Amen.

translations.text: Lord, attend graciously to our supplications, so that, as we believe the Savior of the human race to be with you in your majesty, we may experience his remaining with us until the end of the age, as he himself promised. Who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, for ever and ever. R. Amen.
